AuthConfig.description:
HTTP Basic auth for the dashboard.

The dashboard has no other access control, so when it is exposed through
the central-deploy gateway (an unauthenticated reverse proxy) this MUST
be set — otherwise the cost data is public. When either field is empty
the dashboard is served open (local dev / SSH-tunnel only). ``/health``
is always exempt so the container healthcheck works.

username.description: Dashboard HTTP Basic auth username. Empty means the dashboard is served open.
username.title: Username

password.description: Dashboard HTTP Basic auth password. Empty means the dashboard is served open.
password.title: Password

AuthConfig.title: AuthConfig

Settings.description: Global dashboard settings — no per-project config (registry-driven).

auth.description: HTTP Basic auth — REQUIRED when exposed via the gateway (see AuthConfig).

server_host.description: Bind address for the dashboard web server.
server_host.title: Server Host

server_port.description: Port for the dashboard web server.
server_port.title: Server Port

registry_base_url.description: Central-deploy registry base URL — projects are discovered at runtime.
registry_base_url.title: Registry Base Url

registry_api_key.description: API key for authenticating to the central-deploy registry. When deployed by robotsix-central-deploy with the robotsix.deploy.access: "agent" label, leave empty — the DEPLOY_API_KEY environment variable is injected automatically at deploy time.
registry_api_key.title: Registry Api Key

registry_poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between registry re-polls (0 = only at startup + manual refresh).
registry_poll_interval_seconds.title: Registry Poll Interval Seconds

default_window_hours.description: Default cost-aggregation window in hours (e.g. 168 = 7 days).
default_window_hours.title: Default Window Hours

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds before cached Langfuse data is considered stale and re-fetched.
cache_ttl_seconds.title: Cache Ttl Seconds

dashboard_refresh_interval_seconds.description: Background cache-refresh interval — keeps dashboard aggregates precomputed so the frontend never blocks on a live Langfuse fetch. 0 disables.
dashboard_refresh_interval_seconds.title: Dashboard Refresh Interval Seconds

reconcile_tolerance_usd.description: Maximum allowed difference in USD between provider cost and traced cost before reconciliation is flagged as out of tolerance.
reconcile_tolerance_usd.title: Reconcile Tolerance Usd

reconcile_schedule_hours.description: Auto-run reconciliation every N hours (0 disables; default daily). The stored result drives the dashboard warning banner.
reconcile_schedule_hours.title: Reconcile Schedule Hours

subscription_call_cap.description: Per-day subscription call cap for volume-vs-cap monitoring; 0 = disabled/unknown.
subscription_call_cap.title: Subscription Call Cap

low_balance_threshold_usd.description: OpenRouter account remaining-balance threshold in USD. When the remaining balance drops below this value a warning is logged and surfaced in the dashboard. Set to 0 to disable the low-balance check.
low_balance_threshold_usd.title: Low Balance Threshold Usd

data_dir.description: Runtime data directory for persistence (.data by default; /data in containers).
data_dir.title: Data Dir

log_level.description: Minimum log level for all loggers.
log_level.title: Log Level

mill_base_url.description: Base URL of the robotsix-mill board API (e.g. "http://mill:8080"). When empty, stuck-ticket detection is disabled.
mill_base_url.title: Mill Base Url

mill_api_key.description: API key for authenticating to the mill board API. When deployed by robotsix-central-deploy with the robotsix.deploy.access: "agent" label, leave empty — the DEPLOY_API_KEY env var is used as a fallback.
mill_api_key.title: Mill Api Key

stuck_ticket_threshold_hours.description: Hours a ticket may remain in a non-terminal state before it is flagged as stuck. 0 disables stuck-ticket detection.
stuck_ticket_threshold_hours.title: Stuck Ticket Threshold Hours
